en.title: AI Financial Controller
en.text: Exploring a financial decision-support tool for Kenyan SMEs. The design separates deterministic financial checks and structured evidence from AI explanations and recommendations.
list: Zoho Books integration and reporting concepts

en.title: Road Condition AI
en.text: An ongoing semester project using the RDD2022 road-damage dataset. Work includes XML annotation processing, dataset exploration, preprocessing, and research into mobile model integration.
list: Road-damage classes D00, D01, D10, D11, D20, D40, D43, D44, D50
Model evaluation remains ongoing; no performance claim is made

en.title: Construction Fleet Management
en.text: Designing a web-first fleet and construction-material delivery platform with driver workflows, dispatcher monitoring, GPS updates, delivery management, and a backend database.
